_comment: Standing context cost of registering an MCP server, so 'registering it is free' can never be asserted again without a re-measurement. Written by Phase 0.2 of road-to-skill-delivery-over-mcp. Recompute: tests/scripts/mcp_lite_tools.test.ts asserts both figures against the live surface, so a drift is a red test, not a stale row.
tool_search_threshold: MCP tool definitions are deferred by Claude Code Tool Search only above ~10% of the context window; below it a server's definitions load upfront on every session
note: The roadmap's premise said the allowlist descriptions measure about 1972 tok. That figure is NOT reproducible at this commit: descriptions measure 1791 tok. More importantly it counts the wrong thing — the host loads the whole tools/list payload, schemas included, which is 3886 tok, roughly 2.2x the descriptions-only figure. Both are recorded; the payload figure is the one that belongs against the threshold.

_comment: The lite (turnkey stdio) server after Phase 1.1 + 1.2, for the same comparison. The roadmap caps this surface at 600 tok and the cap is asserted in the test named above.
tool_search_threshold: same threshold as the kernel row above — a 2-tool server is far below it and therefore also loads upfront, which is why the cap exists
